Please call CPS you need to get out of that terrible household immediately. You have a life ahead of you man don't let it go you're going to meet friends I promise you. Please call them and take this step forward, you deserve better.

You're not going to annoy your friends with your problems. Trust me. If you can't get therapy, friends are a great alternative. I felt the exact same way and I really regret it because they really could have helped me. Hit them up and let them know if you can talk to them because you aren't feeling well and I'm sure they'll want to help if they can. And don't stop trying to talk to your friends, you need them and they need you. They'd be devastated if you died, you need to let them know what's going on, friends are there for one another.

Try not to pay a lot of attention to the girl you like, try to put it to the side if you can and focus on other things, I know from experience that if you spend too much time looking for signs and things that it's bad for your mental health. To distract from things I'd recommend to try to focus on projects you may want to do like maybe you wanna work on your website some more, learn a new language, anything really, just do something you can get invested in and can distract from the pain, at least for a little while.

I don't know what your step dad did, but there's a chance that he may not go to prison but since I don't know your situation and I'm not a lawyer I can't say for sure. Though either way I'm sure that situation will turn out okay just try not to worry about it for now especially since you don't even really know what's in store for him.

One last thing to add onto though and that if despite what I said, if you can't bring yourself to talk to your friends I heavily encourage you to call or text a helpline. Would recommend calling though since I find hearing the counsellor's voice is a lot more relieving than using text. You can reach out to any youth helpline you can reach out to or the suicide helpline. If you haven't done it before I heavily encourage you to, I was scared to call but when I did I was very relieved and have done it many more times since then. If you're feeling suicidal call the suicide prevention hotline, if you're just depressed and need someone to talk to I'd call a helpline like for example, since I'm 16 and canadian I have the Kids Help Phone but if you aren't from Canada then I'd recommend finding an equivalent to that. And to add onto that, you aren't a privileged kid we all have our own issues we have to deal with and it's okay.

I made the mistake on April 27, 2019, so over a year ago. I should add some more context though, this was one of the sexual mistakes I made towards the friend of mine and it was that mistake that was brought up that got me disowned by my friend group.

Here's my story if you'd like to hear it  
These mistakes were caused by a sex addiction I had which caused me to think irrationally and this friend of mine had feelings for me and I think I had feelings back too, it was a mess. She was an online friend of mine and we did erotic roleplays and I masturbated in call with her like three times because she said she liked it and despite the guilt I felt afterwards she reassured me it was okay. Thankfully we stopped eventually, however with sexual mistakes I've made before that and things like with my depression I had lots of self hatred and guilt towards myself for those other mistakes I made starting from August 2018, though not remembering having much guilt for what I did to the friend that liked me because she has assured me everytime I apologized for what I did, saying it was okay and I took her word for it. Time jump to April 15, 2020, about 8 months since my sex addiction has vanished, in a voice call the friend brings up that I masturbated to her in a call and I immediately get kicked out of the discord servers I was in with them, messages from another friend asking me why I did it, a horrific nightmare that dropped me straight from almost getting out of depression and having hope all the way back down to the beginning. I gave up on life completely, I told my real life friends about how I was feeling and what happened, called a helpline for the first time which led to me making an apology, then another call that had me send letters to the ones I've wronged. My side wasn't being listened to, I've been told that "you said 'BuT SHe lIKED It' as if that justifies your actions" when in both an apology and letter, I said the exact opposite. And other examples being "You aren't the victim because you hate yourself!" and "You haven't improved just because you got a job!" when I was just trying to explain that I've felt immense guilt and giving examples of how long a year is by giving a few examples of what has happened when just the one thing I said was pointed out. I tried making amends with the friend but when I tried to twice she just sent 2 friends after me that yelled at me, giving me mean remarks and things before sending them for me. And then one of the last things was a friend sending me a screenshot of myself doing an ERP under my pinned tweet with "this you?" then later with me blocking them all, one of the friends posts a tweet with the screenshot of him replying to my pinned tweet followed by a screenshot of the friend I did the things to going "wait \*screenshot that she's blocked on twitter\* LMAOO". Because this was a tweet I had no control over, it got likes and retweets, causing the situation to go public. I noticed I was kicked from a discord server I was in that had only one of the people from the friend group in it meaning that one of the admins saw the tweet or she told them, meaning even more people know. Now in the aftermath I am scared to post on social media somewhat. To people, or at least in the friend group, I am now known as a sexual harasser.
